A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we solve the problem of exact controllability for a cascade of $$2$$ hyperbolic PDEs, by a single local control and the problem of existence of exact insensitivity for the scalar multidimensional wave equation.
we give a complete description of the controllability of cascade systems of hyperbolic PDE’s, as well as of insensitizing exact control problems for the scalar wave PDE.

we give necessary and sufficient conditions for the exact controllablity, by a reduced set of controls, of abstract coupled cascade hyperbolic and parabolic systems, and the existence of insensitizing exact boundary and distributed controls for scalar multidimensional wave systems, by using the two-level energy methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a cascade system, the observability of the system is equivalent to the controllability by a single control of the system.
, in the case of a scalar equation, we can use a control which is a function of a single variable, i.e. a one-dimensional control, in order to insensitize a multidimensional equation.
the energy method can be adapted to non-symmetric coupled cascade systems and can be used in the case of insensitizing control problems.
